how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-13-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:78830:title: Terror of the Desert Skies
rows.quest:78830:details:0:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the ⟦E22⟧ as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the ⟦E22⟧, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
rows.quest:78830:progress:0: How goes the hunt? Surely the bird hasn't got you beat!
rows.quest:78830:completion:0: Now there's a feather for your cap! Nicely done, ⟦3⟧ . ⟦4⟧ You can rest here for a while, if you like. I'm sure your trek through the desert was arduous.

rows.quest:65610:details:0:
I met Krilge while making ⟦E26⟧ in ⟦E27⟧. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at ⟦E28⟧ before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to ⟦E27⟧ and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
rows.quest:65610:completion:0: What is it you have there, ⟦5⟧ ? A scarf made of... ⟦E26⟧? You best not be seeking to romance me.
